label: DS-17 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 17 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit NUCS and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the NUCS source working identifier, the individual DS-17 gene and protein, the DS-17 HMM profile row, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, the PDDEXK HHpred-domain annotation, the absent DS-17 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved DS-17 component activity and phage readouts, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
